bounded_profile.execution_boundary: The current trainer converts profile_steps to max_batches=warmup+steps, profiles fit batches, reports and returns before evaluation/checkpoint saving; --no-eval-during-fit is also explicit. This is a short throughput/memory profile, not a teacher fit or score.
bounded_profile.gradient_validity: The canonical profile evidence gate requires complete GradStats observations when GradScaler is disabled. --grad-stats records pre-clip gradient norms and nonfinite steps for all 120 attempted optimizer updates; without it gradient_finite is null and valid_for_throughput is false.
bounded_profile.propensity_gate: Before profile/fit, require the named clean propensity run to complete successfully and bind its checkpoint identity. This profile uses checkpoint inference, not a propensity cache.

head_layers.main_t3_metadata_boundary: The available frozen student recipe binds hidden=256, two recurrent layers, linear encoding and 23 output channels (2 main + 19 structure + 2 next), but does not separately pin readout depth. The candidate explicitly sets current default 1; historical equivalence is not asserted.
head_layers.semantics: 1 means one hidden readout affine (head.0) followed by GELU and the terminal output affine (head.2); it is not one total linear layer.

optimizer.current_source_semantics: Muon covers GRU gate matrices (three row blocks per stacked gate matrix) plus every other eligible trainable 2-D matrix except input projection and terminal head.2 output weight. Input projection, terminal output, vectors and biases use the non-Muon AdamW-style path. This is the current-source definition of all, not proof of archived semantics.
optimizer.fp32_adaptation: The archived candidate is documented as FP16; strict FP32 and FP32 Newton-Schulz are an explicit clean rebuild adaptation, not exact historical reproduction.

performance_flags.fused_adam: Intentionally omitted: the current optimizer factory selects MuonAdamW for --optim muon, so --fused-adam does not make the non-Muon groups fused AdamW.

performance_flags.selected: --sync-free --pin-memory; do not use --fast for this profile because current --fast also enables --prop-cache, whose cache is not bound/created here.
